\* Introduction  
 Kotaro's Pako Pako Dungeon Ecstasy is a classic first-person 3D Dungeon RPG.   
 Explore the twists and turns of grid design lairs where monster girls roam.   
 Customize your characters, collect and forge items, go on quests, all the cornerstones of roleplaying!   
 Easily controlled with the mouse.   
  
 \* Defeat the bosses to capture monster girls!   
 When you defeat high powered enemies you can "get" monster girls.   
 Of course that means you can have sex, but also add them to your party.   
 There's more fun to be had than just sex. More monsters means more variable battle strategies!   
  
 \* Story   
 A cataclysm turned the cave in an abandoned town into a monster den.   
 It was a fine location for amateur spelunker Kotaro to take his hobby to the next level.   
 When he heard about this cave from a mysterious female pervert he was doubly excited.   
 "I'll find the monster girls and plunder their p\*ssies!"  
  
 Kotaro sets off into the dangerous cave to fulfill his heart's dark desire.
